title: Dance Contest Messages
label: 問1
passageHtml:
Messages about the School Dance Contest

Maya: The final rehearsal has moved from Friday to Thursday at 4:15 in the gym. Please bring the blue team shirts.
Ken: I have science club until 4:30 on Thursday. Can someone show me the changes later?
Maya: Sure. We will record the new ending. Watch it before Saturday morning.
Lena: I can bring Ken's shirt because his is still at my house.

questions.question: What changed about the rehearsal?
questions.evidence: The final rehearsal has moved from Friday to Thursday.
questions.reason_ja: FridayからThursdayへ変更されたため、変わったのは曜日です。

questions.question: What should Ken do before Saturday morning?
questions.evidence: We will record the new ending. Watch it before Saturday morning.
questions.reason_ja: 欠席部分は録画で確認するよう指示されています。

questions.question: Why will Lena bring an extra shirt?
options: Ken left it at her house
Maya asked her to buy one
questions.answer: Ken left it at her house
questions.evidence: Ken's shirt ... is still at my house.
questions.reason_ja: 所有場所を示す情報を直接読み取ります。
